# Costfluent Provider

Terraform provider for managing Costfluent cloud cost management resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    costfluent = {
      source  = "costfluent/costfluent"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "costfluent" {
  # api_key = var.costfluent_api_key  # Or set COSTFLUENT_API_KEY
  # workspace = "wsp_default"        # Optional default workspace
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Costfluent API key. Can also be set via COSTFLUENT_API_KEY environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Costfluent API base URL. Can also be set via COSTFLUENT_BASE_URL environment variable. Defaults to https://api.costfluent.com
- `timeout` (Number) Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.
- `workspace` (String) Default workspace token for workspace-scoped resources. Can also be set via COSTFLUENT_WORKSPACE environment variable.
